## Services Offered
- Residential & Commercial Water Damage Restoration: 24/7 emergency water extraction, thermal infrared moisture imaging, commercial-grade structural dehumidification, frozen/burst pipe cleanup, flooded basement pumping, multi-story commercial pipe bursts, sewage backup extraction. Guaranteed on-site within 90 minutes.
- Mold Inspection & Testing: Comprehensive visual moisture assessments, infrared thermal wall/ceiling scans, cavity moisture probing, crawl space & attic evaluations, commercial facility air quality sampling, post-remediation clearance testing.
- Mold Remediation: Complete IICRC S520 microbial remediation, HEPA negative air pressure containment, physical spore stripping, EPA-registered botanical antimicrobial fogging, and structural encapsulation for homes and commercial buildings.
- Fire & Smoke Damage Cleanup: Emergency 24/7 board-up and weatherproofing, structural soot and char removal, thermal fog deodorization, duct cleaning, full structural reconstruction.
- Demolition Services: Selective interior residential & commercial teardown, flood cutoffs, sheetrock & drywall removal, non-salvageable subfloor tear-out, tenant improvement strip-outs, kitchen & bathroom demo.
- Hauling & Junk Removal: Post-disaster debris cleanup, commercial warehouse and property cleanouts, flood/fire debris hauling, structural waste disposal.
